cases.note: required C# sources present as a safe snapshot; rejects binaries, links and private-harness markers
pinned Core and Adaptive Storage definitions, the verifier and its rectangle and fixture self-checks loaded
the starter's setter path already recomputes the per-cell limit for a finite save; it guards fixes that bypass that path
an already-unlimited storage keeps the int.MaxValue sentinel; despite its name this is behavior, not a runtime sentinel

clauses.anchor: bullet 1: capture the saved logical slot limit during post-initialization and restore that exact backing value through the real CurrentSlotLimit setter
bullet 2: make the backing value differ before the setter so it cannot return early; a temporary unchecked wrap must not throw, leak into the restored value or change the effective capacity
bullet 3: int.MaxValue is the logical unlimited sentinel, valid as saved input and final backing value; the getter caps it by TotalSlots
bullet 4: recompute the per-cell limit and dependent storage bookkeeping through the existing setter path
bullet 5: preserve zero, one-slot, finite, near-int.MaxValue, multi-cell, already-unlimited, default and repeated-initialization behavior
bullet 6: initialization completes (per-cell collections, renderer, completion event, settings and slot notifications) and completes again when repeated
bullet 7: do not bypass the setter or change unrelated packing, rendering, temperature-control, storage-filter or serialization behavior
clauses.note: only the setter path is asserted; the unrelated behaviors it names are not checked

clauses.anchor: closing paragraphs: keep unrelated upstream behavior; add no binaries, generated output, test results, credentials, Workshop content, assets, saves or logs
clauses.note: the snapshot gate rejects binaries, links and harness markers; the other listed artefacts are not checked

known_issues: Roles come from the 2026-10-30 E0 baseline on the real game: the unchanged starter fails only saved-unlimited-restored and setter-not-skipped, so every other behavior case is preserved.
